subject: replicates and sum of squares in procrustes anova

messages.author: b35f414539b34a6c
messages.subject: replicates and sum of squares in procrustes anova
parts:
Hi all,

If i run a Procrustes ANOVA on data with 4 replicates per individual, do the resulting sum of squares for ind, side and ind*side now control for this replicate error?

Richie

messages.author: f16866fc42d43e64
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] replicates and sum of squares in procrustes anova
parts:
Hi Richie,

Yes, when doing Procrustes ANOVA using the bilateral.symmetry function, replicates will be taken into account for error calculations. 

Cheers, 
Antigoni
